english.note: Use this when the emphasis is that the person is rightfully entitled to receive something.
Use this when stressing that someone is entitled to receive something because they deserve it.

examples.english: This overtime pay is what you deserve, so don't be so polite.
examples.traditional: 呢筆加班費係你應得嘅，唔使客氣。

examples.english: They worked so hard and merit this award.
